fato_historico: 1956: Soviet troops enter Hungary to end the Hungarian revolution against the Soviet Union that started on October 23. Thousands are killed, more are wounded, and nearly a quarter million leave the country.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle tide pulling you inward to reflect on the importance of peace and home. Just as the winds of history once shifted to remind us of the fragility of freedom, you are called to build resilience within your heart. Consider creating a quiet space where your spirit can thrive and find safety amidst any external changes.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is a home that nobody can ever take away from you.
significado_numero: A master builder number representing harmony, balance and grounded emotional strength.
conselho: Protect your gentle heart today by focusing on comfort and peaceful, quiet routines.
